It presents this through the stronger sublevel-segment inclusion rather than directly as the missing Taylor neighborhood argument, while also recognizing the undefined c issue.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns the segment used in the optimal-gain proof and the definition of U^epsilon. ISSUE-004 identifies the same failure of the periodic boundedness proof: a 1/h accumulation factor, an argument verified only at one step size, and an invalid use of an upper O(epsilon^theta) bound where a lower threshold bound is required. Its repair supplies the common-threshold, h-dependent level choice and induction needed for all sufficiently small h.
